_readme: Third Gutenberg batch (items 31-40 of the import plan). All texts fetched and read from gutenberg.org before writing synopses/mentions.

books.title: Ann Veronica
books.author: H. G. Wells
books.synopsis: A restless young woman defies her controlling father to attend a forbidden dance and pursue scientific study in London, then leaves home outright for an independent life of suffragette activism, romance, and self-invention.

books.title: The New Machiavelli
books.author: H. G. Wells
books.synopsis: A rising British politician's illicit love affair detonates his Parliamentary career, and in exile on the Italian Riviera he writes a bitter memoir of how desire wrecked his ambition to become a modern Machiavelli.

books.title: Clayhanger
books.author: Arnold Bennett
books.synopsis: Edwin Clayhanger leaves school dreading a confrontation with his formidable father Darius, a self-made printer in the industrial Five Towns, and is pressed into the family business just as his own ambitions begin to stir.

books.title: The Card
books.author: Arnold Bennett
books.synopsis: Denry Machin, an audacious young clerk in provincial Bursley, crashes a countess's ball and parlays the resulting fame into rent-collecting schemes, moneylending, and increasingly outrageous acts of generosity that make him the town's beloved rogue.

books.title: Elizabeth and Her German Garden
books.author: Elizabeth von Arnim
books.synopsis: An English wife chronicles a year of transforming a neglected estate in rural Germany into her private paradise, sparring wryly with an exasperated husband, eccentric visitors, and the crushing propriety of provincial society.

books.title: Right Ho, Jeeves
books.author: P. G. Wodehouse
books.synopsis: Bertie Wooster's meddling to pair up his shy friend Gussie Fink-Nottle with a sentimental young woman, and to patch up his cousin's broken engagement, spirals into drunken newt-fancier speeches and general chaos that only Jeeves can untangle.

books.title: The Inimitable Jeeves
books.author: P. G. Wodehouse
books.synopsis: Bertie Wooster's lovelorn friend Bingo Little falls for a fresh woman every few weeks, and Jeeves engineers one improbable rescue after another to keep Bingo's romances and Bertie's own entanglements from ending in disaster.

books.title: Psmith, Journalist
books.author: P. G. Wodehouse
books.synopsis: While an editor is away, the imperturbable Psmith and reporter Billy Windsor turn a genteel New York magazine into a crusading exposé of slum tenements, drawing threats from the gangster landlord profiting off the squalor.

books.title: Something Fresh
books.author: P. G. Wodehouse
books.synopsis: A struggling writer and a spirited young woman get swept into Blandings Castle's chaos when a bumbling young lord's old love letters, a stolen Egyptian scarab, and a houseful of scheming guests collide.

books.title: The Wrong Box
books.author: Robert Louis Stevenson and Lloyd Osbourne
books.synopsis: When his uncle dies in a railway accident, Morris Finsbury buries the body and schemes to hide the death and claim a lucrative tontine, but the wrong corpse ends up shipped to London in a packing case, touching off a farce of mistaken identity.

mentions.mentioned: Lives of the Queens of England
mentions.author: Agnes Strickland
